content.title: Cricket Australia to Investigate 2017-18 Ashes Series
content.caption: Cricket Australia will conduct an independent probe into the sandpapergate scandal and the 2017-18 Ashes series against England.

slides.heading: Cricket Australia to Investigate 2017-18 Ashes Series
slides.text: Cricket Australia will conduct an independent probe into the sandpapergate scandal and the 2017-18 Ashes series against England.

slides.heading: Scandal and Series
slides.text: Cricket Australia will investigate the sandpapergate scandal and the 2017-18 Ashes series against England.

slides.heading: Inquiry Scope
slides.text: The inquiry will cover ball-management practices in the Australian men's team during the 2017-18 season, including the Ashes series Australia won 4-0.
